items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: They didn't play at the Dewdrop during the time I was playing there.

ctx.x: At the Dewdrop? Yeah. At the Dewdrop? Okay. And so what, could you tell me how the house band worked at the Dewdrop? Because I know it's different than at other clubs.

Yeah, but you know like all these musicians that they're making a lot over, because they played at the Dewdrop. Now when I was playing at the Dewdrop, a guy like Alan Toussaint and Booker. James Booker? James Booker? Yeah. James Booker? Yeah. They were little boys. They didn't play at the Dewdrop during the time I was playing there. They used to hang around and be outside. They still spend most of the time outside listening to the musicians, you know. But the way they advertised them, like they was a part of the…
Could you tell me what the house band did at the Dewdrop? I mean, what you all?
